title: International Business Developer Middle East Europe
motivazione: Il ruolo richiede almeno 8 anni di esperienza nello sviluppo commerciale internazionale nel settore software per logistica/trasporti; il candidato ha circa 6‑7 anni di esperienza manageriale in digital sales & marketing, ma non ha esperienza specifica nel trasporto su gomma o intermodale. Soddisfa la sede (Genova) e la lingua, ma manca il requisito di seniorità e di settore specifico.

La risorsa avrà la responsabilità di accelerare la crescita del Gruppo nei mercati del centro ed est Europa con particolare rifermento a Germania, Polonia, Romania, Ungheria, Austria, Svizzera e aree limitrofe. Job profile La persona selezionata si occuperà di: Identificare e sviluppare in prima persona opportunità di business nei mercati internazionali di riferimento (e anche collaborando con canali indiretti). Supportare la definizione e implementare la strategia Go-To-Market (GTM) per la penetrazione in nuove aree geografiche e la diversificazione del business su nuovi verticali. Collaborare a stretto contatto con i team di prodotto e sviluppo per tradurre le esigenze dei grandi clienti internazionali in possibili evolutive della roadmap software. Competenze ed esperienze Laurea in Ingegneria (Gestionale, Civile/Trasporti) o in Economia o similare. Esperienza consolidata (almeno 8 anni) nello sviluppo commerciale internazionale (di cui almeno una esperienza in ambito software). Provenienza obbligatoria dai settori logistica e trasporti (software e/o lato business, con obbligatoria la conoscenza approfondita del trasporto su gomma e intermodale). Comprovata capacità di guidare trattative commerciali complesse e e di strutturare processi di vendita efficaci. Ottima conoscenza della lingua inglese (la conoscenza di una seconda lingua come tedesco, polacco o Rumeno sarà considerata un elemento distintivo). Forte orientamento ai risultati e disponibilità a frequenti trasferte internazionali. Cosa offriamo CCNL Applicato: Terziario Commercio / Metalmeccanico industria a seconda della società di assunzione. RAL a partire da 50.000€ da commisurare in base all'effettiva esperienza + MBO. Assunzione diretta in azienda. Ambiente di lavoro giovane, internazionale e inclusivo. Flessibilità oraria e smart working. Corsi di formazione. Possibile sede di lavoro Genova (mainly remote). Circle Group si impegna a creare un ambiente di lavoro sicuro ed inclusivo, basato sul rispetto reciproco ed in grado di garantire Pari Opportunità di lavoro a tutte le candidate e i candidati in possesso delle competenze ricercate. Salva Segnala offerta di lavoro Requirements Description & Requirements who we are lululemon is an innovative performance apparel company for yoga, running, training, and other athletic pursuits. Setting the bar in technical fabrics and functional design, we create transformational products and experiences that support people in moving, growing, connecting, and being well. We owe our success to our innovative product, emphasis on stores, commitment to our people, and the incredible connections we make in every community we're in. As a company, we focus on creating positive change to build a healthier, thriving future. In particular, that includes creating an equitable, inclusive and growth-focused environment for our people. About This Team The Community team at lululemon is responsible for creating, developing and executing regional marketing strategies that inspire and connect key stakeholders, building brand awareness, brand familiarity and brand love across our key markets. The Community Marketing Lead is a people and wellbeing industry leader whom collaborates with key stakeholders and partners to create and implement localised marketing strategy that supports overall brand marketing tactics to acquire new guests. Core Responsibilities Deliver quarterly elevated community programming and experiences through local run, train and yoga partners across key cities in Italy and Spain at key brand campaign and/or cultural moments on the calendar. Act as the marketing relationship holder for the most premium and relevant gyms, studios, run clubs and shopping centres to design and manage bespoke partnerships to grow awareness, seed our core products, and acquire new guests. Project manage the 360-marketing strategy for New Store Openings and New Market Entry, delivering the strategy and executing in close collaboration with cross-functional partners to drive the retail business. Directly coach the store teams, facilitating quarterly strategy meetings and campaign enrolment sessions to build long-term brand equity and support delivering on brand marketing objectives in Spain & Italy Oversee and support the Local Ambassador pipeline and program approval process. Act as the local lululemon representative, identifying, building and maintaining lasting relationships with local key opinion leaders, Ambassadors, gyms, studios, athletes and more. Act as the regional source of truth for strategic insights on the Spain & Italy market Manage strategic materials, budgets and reporting tools Qualifications 5+ years of experience in multi-channel marketing and events (Sports marketing experience preferred) You have a passion for movement and view wellbeing as a way of life. An existing network within the wellbeing and fitness community is preferred. Proven experience of creating marketing plans with proven results Written, presentation and verbal communication skills Fluent in English and either Italian or Spanish (proficiency in both an asset). must haves Acknowledge the presence of choice in every moment and take personal responsibility for your life. Possess an entrepreneurial spirit and continuously innovate to achieve great results. Communicate with honesty and kindness and create the space for others to do the same. Lead with courage, knowing the possibility of greatness is bigger than the fear of failure. Foster connection by putting people first and building trusting relationships. Identify business opportunities by managing hot leads and proactively building your own pipeline of potential clients. Develop and expand the customer portfolio within the assigned geographical area. Support existing customers with a consultative approach, including delivering tailored insights through customized data analysis. Participate in business trade fairs and industry events to strengthen market presence and generate leads.
